from hashlib import sha256
import json
root = Path('products/services/welfare-tender/followon-rehearsal')

for p in files:
    if p.suffix == '.json' and p.stat().st_size <= 4000 and any(word in p.stem.lower() for word in ('accept', 'check', 'result')):
        print(str(p), p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
